name: Burner management and flame safeguard system
description: Safety system that sequences purge, ignition and firing and trips the fuel on loss of flame or failed permissives. Designed to NFPA 85/86, IRI, ISA 84, FM and Gastec practice; flame supervision uses UV or IR viewing heads, with SIL3-capable assemblies available.
